item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Isha draws ray $OC$ from the vertex of $\angle AOB$ in the figure.

When does $OC$ bisect $\angle AOB$?

options.A: Call the answer "crease" only, without checking that the two angles at $O$ are equal.
options.B: Treat $OC$ as a bisector after checking only that it starts at $O$, skipping that $\angle AOC$ must equal $\angle COB$.
options.C: When $\angle AOC = \angle COB$, so ray $OC$ from $O$ splits $\angle AOB$ into two equal angles.
options.D: Say that equal angles $\angle AOC$ and $\angle COB$ are what create ray $OC$, instead of ray $OC$ from $O$ making those two angles.
